title: Agile Roundtable: In Person!
description: Utah Agile Join us in-person at *Silicon Slopes* in Lehi for the Agile Roundtable.  At Agile Roundtables, participants co-create the agenda with the topics they want to discuss. A facilitator guides the team from topic to topic. Then each participant has an opportunity to share what they're taking away from the session. Simple, but powerful!  Agile Roundtables in Utah have been happening monthly since before the Agile Manifesto was written in 2001. Whether you've joined us many times or this is your first, please come! Bring your questions, your challenges, and ideas. You'll walk away from this session not only having gained, but also given something! Even if you don't have a topic in mind, come network and enjoy face-to-face collaboration!  A light lunch will be served.
venue_address: 2600 W. Executive Pkwy. Suite 140, Lehi, UT
